standard_prerequisites.name: The exactness of the sheaf of homomorphisms in the first variable for a right exact sequence, and in the second variable for a left exact sequence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author lemma lemma-internal-hom-exact, whose statement is reproduced verbatim as a context span of this card (source lines 3775-3799)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the exact sequence whose stalk is compared with the corresponding sequence of the stalks.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the stalk of the sheaf of homomorphisms as classes of local homomorphisms, and local generation of a module of finite type by finitely many sections
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof at source lines 3851-3863
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces injectivity to testing the given local homomorphism on finitely many generators.

core_obligations: Describe the map and prove injectivity: after writing an element of the stalk as a class of a local homomorphism, the proof uses finite local generation to find a neighbourhood on which a representative killing the image of the generators vanishes identically, so the class is zero (proof lines 3851-3871)
Local presentation: for the second part the proof reduces to the case of a module admitting a presentation by two finite free modules (proof lines 3874-3886)

Compare exact sequences: the exact sequence of sheaves of homomorphisms coming from the presentation is turned into a sequence of stalks, and it is identified with the sequence computing the homomorphisms of the stalks out of the induced presentation of the stalk, so the two kernels agree (proof lines 3887-3924)
proof_roadmap: 先描述映射：把 (U,φ) 的类送到 φ_x；若 φ_x = 0，取 U 上有限个生成元 s^i，由 φ_x(s^i_x)=0 逐个缩小邻域使 φ(s^i)=0，故 φ|_V = 0，即单射。
再设 F 局部有 O_X^{⊕m} → O_X^{⊕n} → F → 0；由 lemma-internal-hom-exact 得 0 → Hom(F,G) → ⊕G ⟶ ⊕G 正合，取茎后与「由 F_x 的展示诱导的 Hom_{O_{X,x}}(F_x,G_x) → ⊕G_x ⟶ ⊕G_x」比较，两者核相同。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement compares the stalk of the sheaf of homomorphisms from a module to another module with the module of homomorphisms between the stalks, proving injectivity in finite type and bijectivity in finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 3835-3848, label lemma-stalk-internal-hom). The proof (source lines 3850-3925) first tests a local homomorphism on finitely many local generators to get injectivity, then uses a local presentation of the module and the exactness of the sheaf of homomorphisms in the first variable to present both the stalk of the sheaf of homomorphisms and the module of homomorphisms of the stalks as kernels of the same map, whence they agree (proof lines 3887-3924). The comparison of the two exact sequences is the content; the required exactness statement is reproduced verbatim as a context span. H2.
